CustomProperties.Name: AllowSearch
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Show or hide internal search box.

CustomProperties.Name: Items
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Flat tree rows to render. Required fields RowNodeId, RowParentNodeId, RowLevel, RowLabel, RowDescription, RowSortPath.

CustomProperties.Name: OnSelectNode
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Raised when the user selects a node.

CustomProperties.Name: SearchText
CustomProperties.Tooltip: External search text. Leave blank if using the internal search box.

Rules.InvariantScript:
Table(
    {
        RowNodeId: "",
        RowParentNodeId: "",
        RowLevel: 1,
        RowLabel: "",
        RowDescription: "",
        RowSortPath: "",
        RowIcon: ""
    }
)

SortByColumns(
    Filter(
        cmp_TreeViewPro.Items,
        IsBlank(Coalesce(cmp_TreeViewPro.SearchText, varTree_SearchText)) ||
        StartsWith(
            Lower(Text(RowLabel)),
            Lower(Text(Coalesce(cmp_TreeViewPro.SearchText, varTree_SearchText)))
        ) ||
        StartsWith(
            Lower(Text(RowDescription)),
            Lower(Text(Coalesce(cmp_TreeViewPro.SearchText, varTree_SearchText)))
        )
    ),
    "RowSortPath",
    SortOrder.Ascending
)

If(
    Text(ThisItem.RowNodeId) = Text(varTree_SelectedNodeId) ||
    Text(ThisItem.RowNodeId) = Text(cmp_TreeViewPro.SelectedNodeId),
    cmp_TreeViewPro.SelectionFill,
    Color.Transparent
)

If(
    Text(ThisItem.RowNodeId) = Text(varTree_SelectedNodeId) ||
    Text(ThisItem.RowNodeId) = Text(cmp_TreeViewPro.SelectedNodeId),
    cmp_TreeViewPro.AccentColor,
    cmp_TreeViewPro.TextColor
)

If(
    Text(ThisItem.RowNodeId) = Text(varTree_SelectedNodeId) ||
    Text(ThisItem.RowNodeId) = Text(cmp_TreeViewPro.SelectedNodeId),
    FontWeight.Semibold,
    If(Value(ThisItem.RowLevel) = 1, FontWeight.Semibold, FontWeight.Normal)
)

Switch(
    Value(ThisItem.RowLevel),
    1, Icon.Database,
    2, Icon.Folder,
    3, Icon.Document,
    Icon.Document
)

Switch(
    Value(ThisItem.RowLevel),
    1, cmp_TreeViewPro.AccentColor,
    2, ColorValue("#0EA5E9"),
    3, cmp_TreeViewPro.MutedTextColor,
    cmp_TreeViewPro.MutedTextColor
)
